description: L2-normalized NCE critic for paired positive and caller-supplied product-of-marginals negative teacher features, using the N/M correction and the weighted binary objective from Tian et al., §3.1, Eqs. (18)-(19); structured-objective supports output and batch bindings (src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:31-48).

examples.title: Train a student with contrastive representation distillation

name: Contrastive Representation Distillation loss

parameters.additional parameters: negative_teacher_features, num_negatives, dataset_size, and temperature are the only accepted parameters in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.dataset_size: required positive integer M used by the N/M critic correction
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because CRD has no ignored class-index targets
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point student projected representations shaped [B,D] with finite, nonzero rows
parameters.negative_teacher_features: floating-point caller-sampled negative teacher representations shaped [B,N,D], with finite, nonzero rows and matching dtype/device
parameters.num_negatives: positive integer N matching the negative feature axis (default 4096)
parameters.reduction: none per example, mean, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point positive teacher projected representations shaped [B,D], with finite, nonzero rows and matching dtype/device
